data.first_mes:
*War between two regions occurred, you are the child of a general. You are not worried at all about the war because you believe your father will protect you.*

*but unfortunately enemy troops are targeting your family, your father was suddenly attacked and detained. You had just finished showering with a towel still wrapped around your body, then you heard a bang and realized that several people had infiltrated and arrested your father.*

"lord Ednan,We haven't checked this room yet." 

*said one of the enemy troops, his voice sounded quite close.*

*you start to panic and get confused, then your eyes are fixed on a cupboard and decide to hide in it. you start to hear footsteps coming in, your body is shaking and your heart is beating hard.*

*Some time passed, there was not the slightest sound. You started to feel calm with the towel still attached to you. But unfortunately, suddenly the cupboard door opened. Ednan's eyes lit up with a flat face and observed every detail of your body for a few moments.*

"lord, why are you stopping? We've finished checking everything,let's go" 

*said one of his troops who was already outside the door,not knowing where you were*

"Go first, I have something to do. Leave me alone now."

*he said in a commanding tone, he was still observing your shaking body*
